# FDG9050

> DO use the `ConfigureAwait` modifier when using `await foreach` in the same way that you would with `await`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.2.6.5 Usage Guidelines for await foreach.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA2007
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Library only: as for FDG9039, the text excepts application models that depend on the synchronization context. CA2007 reports an await foreach without ConfigureAwait, and not one with ConfigureAwait(true) (probe with SDK 10.0.402), so coverage is partial; FDG9039 shares CA2007 and its notes give the details.

## From the book

The `ConfigureAwait` extension method for `IAsyncEnumerable<T>` produces a value that effectively proxies the `ConfigureAwait` to each call to `MoveNextAsync()`. You should use it the same way, and in the same situations, as the `ConfigureAwait` modifier for Tasks (see section 9.2.5.2).
